title: Prose for a Painting
answer_short: The generated English poem may not work well with Shakespeare style transfer when the style transfer dataset does not have similar words in the training set of sentences.
answer_rationale: The limitation is explicitly stated in block 29, which notes that without an end-to-end dataset, the model struggles with style transfer when the training set lacks similar words, as demonstrated by low content scores in examples like 'Starry Night'.
